model_annotations.Bulgarian: The diagram presents a circular arrangement of various types of characters, divided into three main categories: Custom Characters, Virtual Characters, and Real Characters. Each category encompasses different types of characters, specifically dividing them into nine segments. The Custom Characters segment includes Actors and Influencers, the Virtual Characters segment is subdivided into Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, and Novel Characters, while the Real Characters segment is further divided into Comic Characters, Game Characters, Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers. The diagram utilizes distinct colors for each category, providing a clear visual distinction between the types of characters.
model_annotations.English: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of different types of characters. The total number of slices, representing various categories, is sixteen. Each slice denotes a unique category as follows: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, Game Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters. Specific percentages are not provided, but there is no shade differentiation in the slices, nor are there labels for individual proportions inside the slices. The chart does not indicate any visual emphasis techniques such as exploded, offset, or bolded slices. The segments are ordered in a regular pattern without any particular sequence like descending size.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Kreisdiagramm veranschaulicht die vielfältigen Kategorien von Charakteren und Persönlichkeiten, die in der Unterhaltungsbranche und anderen Bereichen relevant sind. Es ist in drei Hauptsegmente unterteilt: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters und Real Characters. Jeder Abschnitt ist wiedergebend für Schauspieler, wobei die Kategorien Literarisch (Romanhändler), Filmisch (Filmemacher), Spiele (Spieleentwickler), Musik und andere unterscheidet. Die Unterkategorien von Anpassern umfassen Enthusiasten, Fans und Spieler. Die Vertreter werden generell dargestellt und im Bereich der Unterstützer zwischen Schöpfer und Pädagogen unterschieden. Diese mentale Tabelle umfasst sechs Schichten und den zweiten Punkt unter diesem in ukrainischer Sprache.
